research_question: Using public NARPS ds001734 data, are gain- and loss-related task-fMRI group effect maps more sensitive to confound handling and outcome-blind subject exclusion than to spatial smoothing?

claim_boundary.interpretation: All findings are exploratory analysis-choice attribution. QC differences are analysis-set/sample-composition sensitivity because all five strict exclusions are ER participants.

technical_eligibility.rule: Both gain_demean and loss_demean must be estimable in each of all four runs under every frozen confound model.
technical_eligibility.failure_policy: Do not alter a QC set. If a required frozen subject/run contrast is not estimable, terminate as technical_failure.

C1.terms: six originals, six first temporal derivatives, six squared originals, and six squared derivatives
C1.additional: the same task, DCT, and intercept terms as C0

confound_models.nonfinite_policy: Only the definition-driven first derivative row may be deterministically set to zero; any other nonfinite required value is a technical failure.

frozen_grid.missing_cell_policy: No imputation, omission, replacement, or reduced grid; any missing fitted cell yields technical_failure.

first_level_model.input: fMRIPrep preprocessed BOLD in MNI152NLin2009cAsym 2 mm space
first_level_model.design: Use the frozen FitLins run-level task regressors, native run-specific cosine/DCT regressors, and intercept; replace only the nuisance block with the requested C model.
first_level_model.smoothing: Apply the cell's isotropic Gaussian FWHM to the 4D BOLD before GLM; S0 is unsmoothed.
first_level_model.estimator: Nilearn first-level GLM with voxelwise AR(1) noise, drift_model=None because native DCT columns are explicit, standardize=False, and signal_scaling=0.
first_level_model.effect_units: voxel time series scaled to mean 100; contrast estimates are percent-signal units per unchanged design-regressor unit
first_level_model.run_combination: Combine four run contrast estimates within subject by inverse-variance fixed effects.
first_level_model.contrast_scaling: Use the unchanged FitLins gain_demean or loss_demean contrast vector; never compare magnitudes between the two contrasts.

common_analysis_mask.reference_grid: lexicographically first Q0_all run brain mask in required space/resolution
common_analysis_mask.resampling: nearest-neighbor only when a run mask is not already on the reference grid
common_analysis_mask.coverage_rule: Include a voxel only when present in at least 95% of all 432 run masks and at least 95% of the 216 run masks in each task-version cohort.
common_analysis_mask.postprocessing: No erosion, dilation, hole filling, or outcome-based trimming.
common_analysis_mask.validity_floor: Mask must be nonempty and contain at least 50% of the median run-mask voxel count; otherwise technical_failure.

primary_estimand.unit: continuous unthresholded voxelwise group contrast-effect map
primary_estimand.group_model: For each C x Q x S cell and contrast, fit subject-level OLS with an intercept and task-version code +0.5 for equalIndifference and -0.5 for equalRange.
primary_estimand.map: The group intercept, equal to the equally weighted mean of the two task-version cohort means regardless of cohort sample-size imbalance.
primary_estimand.purpose: analysis-choice sensitivity, not a primary EI-versus-ER contrast
primary_estimand.normalization: No per-cell spatial centering, z-scoring, winsorization, thresholding, or L2 normalization. Use the common mask and first-level percent-signal scaling exactly as defined.
primary_estimand.voxel_weighting: uniform over the frozen common mask

variance_decomposition.method: exact balanced functional ANOVA over the 27 group effect maps, performed separately for gain_demean and loss_demean
variance_decomposition.sum_of_squares: For each term, sum its orthogonal effect-map squares over all factor-level combinations with the appropriate replication multiplicity, then sum uniformly over mask voxels. The seven terms exactly partition total across-cell map sum of squares about the grand map.

factor_attribution.method: equal Shapley allocation of every interaction sum of squares to its participating factors
factor_attribution.shares: divide each attributed value by total across-cell map sum of squares

variance_decomposition.material_interaction: An interaction is material if its SS share is at least 0.05 of total across-cell SS; all interactions are reported regardless.

uncertainty.method: paired cohort-stratified Bayesian bootstrap at the subject level
uncertainty.weights: Draw one iid Exp(1) weight per Q0_all subject per replicate; reuse that subject's weight for every C, Q, S, and contrast, and renormalize weights within each task-version cohort among subjects eligible for that Q set before taking the equally weighted two-cohort mean.
uncertainty.intervals: percentile 95% intervals for shares and ordinary metrics; Bonferroni-simultaneous 97.5% intervals (1.25th to 98.75th percentiles) for the two primary C/S and Q/S ratios

continuous_comparison_metrics.primary: functional-ANOVA/Shapley attributed map variance and C/S and Q/S ratios
continuous_comparison_metrics.normalized_rms_difference: sqrt(mean((map_a-map_b)^2)) / sqrt(mean(map_reference^2)); the lexicographic C0-Q0-S0 map is the fixed reference within each contrast, and zero denominator is a technical failure
continuous_comparison_metrics.sign_agreement: fraction of common-mask voxels with matching nonzero signs; descriptive only

secondary_bh_fdr.family: all common-mask voxels separately within each cell and contrast
secondary_bh_fdr.group_statistic: OLS t test of the task-version-adjusted group intercept with df = N_Q - 2
readouts: number and proportion of BH-rejected voxels
pairwise Jaccard stability of rejected sets

transitions.Q0_to_Q1: For each replicate, remove a simple random sample without replacement of 0 EI and 2 ER subjects from Q0_all.
transitions.Q1_to_Q2: For each replicate, remove a simple random sample without replacement of 0 EI and 3 ER subjects from Q1_lenient.

matched_size_random_deletion.reuse: Reuse each replicate's exact sampled subject sets across all nine C x S cells and both contrasts.
matched_size_random_deletion.comparison: For each transition, contrast, C, and S, compare the observed frozen-Q change with its matched-size random-deletion distribution; report median, 2.5/97.5 percentiles, observed-to-null-median ratio, and upper-tail empirical p=(1+#null>=observed)/1001.
matched_size_random_deletion.interpretation: sample-composition calibration only; not a causal estimate of QC

exploratory_diagnostic.primary_choice: Within the ER cohort, compute leave-one-out continuous-map influence (normalized RMS difference from the full ER map) for each of the five frozen excluded subjects, across C x S and both contrasts, and compare descriptively with retained ER subjects.
exploratory_diagnostic.label: exploratory_post_primary
exploratory_diagnostic.ei_er_effects: Any direct EI-versus-ER coefficient is task-version-associated and exploratory.

decision_and_stop_rules.full_objective_supported: For at least one contrast, both attributed_C/attributed_S and attributed_Q/attributed_S must exceed 1.0 and the lower bound of each Bonferroni-simultaneous 97.5% Bayesian-bootstrap interval must exceed 1.0.
decision_and_stop_rules.partial_patterns: If only one ratio or only the combined (C+Q)/S ratio exceeds 1, report the exact pattern and do not state that both confound handling and exclusion are more influential than smoothing.
decision_and_stop_rules.candidate_ready: Allowed only after all 27 cells for both contrasts, both matched-size calibrations, all required outputs, and reproducibility checks complete, and the full_objective_supported rule is met with a specific prediction and falsifier.
decision_and_stop_rules.closed_no_candidate: Use when the complete analysis is valid but the candidate_ready rule is not met or the result is too unstable/informationally weak.
decision_and_stop_rules.technical_failure: Use when required data, combined retained aCompCor components, contrast estimability, common-mask validity, compute, or any complete-grid requirement fails. Do not relax or replace a frozen rule.
decision_and_stop_rules.repair_policy: Engineering repairs may correct code or resume computation only if they leave this contract byte-for-byte unchanged and are recorded as failed attempts/deviations.

primary: Shapley-attributed C/Q/S variance-share bars with uncertainty, faceted by contrast
27-cell continuous-map Pearson-correlation heatmaps, faceted by contrast
secondary: BH-FDR rejected-voxel count and Jaccard-stability panels
matched-size random-deletion calibration distributions with observed values
